decisions.reason: As a clearly positioned, close-to-core turnaround product that strengthens the firm's integrated airport software stack, it remains a low-cost option worth keeping while adoption matures.
The connectivity module still leverages the firm's installed base and system-integration strengths, so the option value of staying in the market outweighs the likely modest cost of continuation.
Equipment monitoring fits tightly with the firm's engineering, maintenance, and lifecycle-service capabilities, making continued retention the more sensible choice absent clear negative signals.
This apron resource module remains close to the core offer and supports the move toward automated end-to-end operations, so it should be kept as a complementary option in the portfolio.
Although safety-oriented tower services can require longer validation and procurement cycles, the product is strategically aligned and still merits being kept open for further market learning.
